content.short: Walapay provides stablecoin-powered API infrastructure for moving and managing money globally.
content.description: Walapay offers stablecoin-based APIs for global money movement and treasury management, aimed at businesses that want settlement speed without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. The pitch across this category is consistent: stablecoins as plumbing the end customer never sees.
content.meta: Stablecoin rails for global money movement, kept invisible to the end customer.
